Quick note from legal ops: the standard UK IDTA (and our addendum) does not have a carveout that explicitly mentions "temporary processors" by that phrase. The operative path we've used in prior reviews is: 

- Treat "temporary" processors as subprocessors subject to the same security controls;
- Require a scoping statement and a written attestation from the temporary provider (access, retention, deletion);
- For escrow-like scenarios, we typically include an operational appendix that limits access and defines escrow triggers.

I've attached the playbook we use when a customer flags an escrow provider — it has the checklist legal will expect. I'll also add a short paragraph we can paste into the cover note for Samantha.

Kim

Attachments: UK_IDTA_temporary_processor_playbook.pdf

Thanks for the ask and the heads-up. Attached is a first-pass, reconciled DTIA inventory focused on APAC/UK subprocessors (DTIA_inventory_v1.csv). We've also included our internal playbook note on how we treat temporary/escrow processors. Key highlights:

Hi Samantha — quick technical answers below; filing for record and next steps: 

1) Escrow vendors: data is staged encrypted by default. For the two escrow providers in scope, we use envelope encryption — customer keys are used to encrypt the master key and we do not store customer plaintext. We will include the encryption architecture diagram in the appendix and an explicit statement that Redwood will not disclose keys to escrow unless contractually triggered.

2) Analytics partner: they receive pseudonymised identifiers (hashed) and a maximum retention of 30 days by policy. We will add a retention statement in the CSV and add a line-item for the attestation asking the analytics partner to confirm no re-identification attempts.

3) On attestations: our standard approach is both — the contractual appendix plus a supplier attestation. Procurement usually expects the provider's signed attestation; we can provide a one-page template they can use.

Next steps: Naomi / Kim + I will assemble the appendix draft + one-page attestation and send back to Samantha by EOD Wednesday.

Regards,
Jonas
